propositions: Transport parameters in reconciler core modules are unannotated or annotated as Any, preventing mypy from enforcing port completeness and allowing members to silently diverge from declared interfaces.

Imports of TicketTransport through the unresolvable rebar_reconciler shim path are silently widened to Any by ignore_missing_imports, making annotations on such imports enforce nothing despite appearing rigorous.
Relative imports of TicketTransport from ._backend restore mypy's attribute-checking, enabling static detection of missing or capability-gated members that the AST audit cannot see.

Capability members (add_comment, set_relationship, get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map) carried as metaclass attributes must be narrowed via composed Protocol views at call sites, never added to TicketTransport's body or widened to Any.
The custom metaclass _TransportPortMeta is load-bearing for uncached isinstance checks in the runtime guard and does not inhibit mypy's enforcement when the import path is resolvable.
